title: Parallel: EPIC Branch Stale
description: Emitted by WorkerPool when a reused EPIC integration branch is found behind its resolved fork base and warned/merged/conflict-degraded (ENH-3302).

run_id.description: Run-scoped identity, stable across a run (including pause/resume). Not required: only FSMExecutor._emit()-routed events stamp it today (ENH-3345); parallel.*/issue.* emitters don't yet (ENH-3346).

loop.description: Loop name, stamped on every FSMExecutor._emit()-routed event (ENH-3345). Not required for the same reason as run_id.

base.description: Resolved fork base the branch was measured/merged against

commits_behind.description: git rev-list --count <branch>..<base> — commits base has that branch lacks
